get_resource_filename: get the absolute file path string for a named AlphaFold 3 resource relative to the data root
open_resource_file: open a named AlphaFold 3 resource file in text or binary mode and return a file object
get_resource_directory: get the path to a named AlphaFold 3 resource directory relative to the data root
walk_resource_tree: walk the AlphaFold 3 resource directory tree and yield directory entries like os.walk
access_data_root: access the AlphaFold 3 common data root path for locating bundled resources and data files
